SELECT COUNT(1) FROM posts WHERE status != 'DELETED'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM comments WHERE status = 'VISIBLE'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM post_favorites
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM reports
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM reports WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')
SELECT CAST(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, created_at, handled_at)) AS SIGNED) FROM reports WHERE handled_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM interaction_events
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(1) AS count FROM posts WHERE created_at >= #{startTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(1) AS count FROM comments WHERE created_at >= #{startTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(1) AS count FROM post_favorites WHERE created_at >= #{startTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(1) AS count FROM reports WHERE created_at >= #{startTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(handled_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(1) AS count FROM reports WHERE handled_at IS NOT NULL AND handled_at >= #{startTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(handled_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT reason_type AS id, reason_type AS name, COUNT(1) AS count FROM reports GROUP BY reason_type ORDER BY count DESC, reason_type ASC

SELECT c.id AS id, c.name AS name, COUNT(1) AS count FROM posts p INNER JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.is_active = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY count DESC, c.name ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.id AS id, t.name AS name, COUNT(1) AS count FROM post_tags pt INNER JOIN tags t ON t.id = pt.tag_id INNER JOIN posts p ON p.id = pt.post_id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY count DESC, t.name ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.id AS id, CONCAT(s.name, COALESCE(CONCAT(' ', s.branch_name), '')) AS name, COUNT(1) AS count FROM posts p INNER JOIN stores s ON s.id = p.store_id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.branch_name ORDER BY count DESC, s.name ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM post_images pi LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.id = pi.post_id WHERE p.id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM post_tags pt LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.id = pt.post_id LEFT JOIN tags t ON t.id = pt.tag_id WHERE p.id IS NULL OR t.id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM posts p LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND (c.id IS NULL OR c.is_active = 0)
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM posts p LEFT JOIN stores s ON s.id = p.store_id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND (s.id IS NULL OR s.status != 'ACTIVE')
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM posts p WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM post_images pi WHERE pi.post_id = p.id )
